sources.reuse: Copied schema validation; new learned-policy code consumes the same civilian scenario contract.
Copied state machine, public mirror, candidate construction, C0/C1 runners, events, and independent task metrics; appended reset/step/export and reward API.
Copied the legacy deterministic C0 and C1 selection rules unchanged; added separate step-mode adapters that reserve visible stock within a minute batch.
Copied explicit public initial-queue handoff and identity calculation.
Copied strict JSON hashing and public decision binding.
Copied event replay, inventory/energy conservation, public-observation, and terminal-state audit; extended accepted policy IDs to L0/L1.

Vendored the source LiteralUAVAttention, LiteralTaskUpdate, deterministic RReLU, shared module definitions, and constructor order; graph_policy.py adapts these locally with dynamic entity masks and candidate mapping.
Vendored SELF_EDGE and UAV_TASK_EDGE constants from the reviewed graph environment; runtime no longer imports the source tree.

adaptations: Graph nodes are sorted public platform and task entities with explicit node type, platform mask, task mask, and node mask.
Candidate IDs bind to entity indices explicitly; actor input contains only public observation plus the public candidate catalog.

Autoregressive masks reserve each delivery's required commodity quantity against public depot stock and visible pre-load delivery commitments; step-mode candidate construction and environment step enforce the same remaining-stock contract, while the legacy run path keeps its original per-candidate stock rule.
The minute-step C0/C1 comparison adapters filter aggregate stock overcommit in stable policy order; legacy choose_actions and ReliefEnv.run retain the copied first-chapter semantics.
Literal message-passing operators and module constructor topology are vendored locally; the deployed package has no runtime import from the old src tree.
L0 uses an entity-wise MLP selected by deterministic static parameter count; L1 calls the locally vendored Literal attention and task-update operators.

The public environment currently encodes no task-predecessor/successor edges; their two first-layer relation matrices are frozen and excluded from effective-capacity matching, while active platform-task message passing remains enabled.

Node feature columns 21 and 56-59 are structurally zero for both entity types; their encoder weights are excluded from L0/L1 effective-capacity counts and are covered by encoded-value and gradient tests.
Linux driver stages run in a token-bound child process supervised by process_guardian.py; resource receipts include wait4 child accounting and record the 250 ms /proc and storage sampling limits.

This v2 identity requires a hash-bound PRIOR_RESOURCE_COST.json receipt; all failed v1 admission, shutdown, and systemd-observed overhead are charged to current per-stage and pilot budgets without importing old ledger rows into the current identity gate.
